text.short: Glendora, on Route 66, 1980. Jean and Elisabeth Sabarots came from the Basque Country; she had worked in a hotel there.
text.today: Lunch and dinner six days, bar until two in the morning every day. Bingo on Tuesday, karaoke on Wednesday, a band on Friday and Saturday, an open jam on Sunday night.
text.note: The only room in this directory whose bar runs later than its kitchen by twelve hours.

seating.note: A restaurant room with a lounge beside it. Reservations through the house's own system.
